{{Quote|They call themselves "Krallet Division." Their leader's a real piece of work, a butcher in a uniform: Captain Jilo Del. These aren't just any Imp soldiers, though.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wo Kasto]]|<ref name="Retribution" />}}
'''Krallet Division''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit loyal to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jilo Del]].<ref name="Krallet" />

==History==
{{Quote|I'm offering you the chance to lead your own company of soldiers. Little to no oversight, access to state-of-the-art weaponry, and your pick of targets.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Acota]] to [[Jilo Del]]|<ref name="Krallet" />}}
Del founded the unit after being betrayed by Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hyshiri]], who turned him over to the Imperial Army in order to sever ties after having tricked him into eradicating a colony that was housing her sister, who had been intending to defect to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After being interrogated by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Acota]], Del was indentured into the Army and promised great compensation in order to form a hit squad of ruthless mercenaries who could be easily disavowed. Under Del's leadership, Krallet Division became known for committing some of the worst atrocities during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Jilo Del">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jilo Del}}</ref>

[[Qrukk]] was a former member of this unit, but he disapproved of Del's indiscriminate slaughter of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and civilians and instead desired to fulfill tasks that strengthened the Empire as a whole. Qrukk plotted to oust Del and take command of the unit, but was betrayed to [[Darth Xarion]] of the [[Dark Council]] by an undercover subordinate who hoped to gain a promotion by reporting him to her master. Xarion, impressed by his skill, placed him as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Imperial Infiltration Specialists]] instead, and sent him to participate in the [[Invasion of Manaan]], to which Qrukk enthusiastically accepted.<ref name="Qrukk" />

Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the group would meet its end when they were ambushed in the [[Temple of the Progenitor]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] by the [[Alliance Commander]], who had been sent by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] Captain [[Wo Kasto]] to make them pay for murdering his [[Wo Kasto's mother|mother]] at the start of the Empire's invasion.<ref name="Retribution" />
